message.content: Your only task: run exactly one Bash command, `sleep 180` (foreground, with a timeout of at least 200000 ms), then reply "done". Do nothing else: don't write or edit any files, start any other processes, or launch agents. Rules: never kill processes by pattern (no pkill, killall, or pgrep piped to kill), never use Computer Use or OS-level input automation, and don't add any model restriction to anything you write.
